description: STREEQ gives an individual controlled access to their own fitness record from ChatGPT. It can read workout, food, body-progress and supported health history; log evidence; and manage the person’s workout programme or nutrition strategy when they own that plan. If an active TRAINEDBY coach owns a plan, STREEQ blocks self-directed plan changes.
